# Feature: Blocker — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #34 (Blocker) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: A guard that shuffles to stay in your way across a doorway. Unique: a doorway guard that moves to stay in your way, not a lock in disguise. Useful: get past by pinning, luring or timing it, never by collecting its orb. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** a guard that shuffles to stay in your way across a doorway.

**So that** get past by pinning, luring or timing it, never by collecting its orb.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Blocker for the first time in its teaching room (mech-34-blocker-room). Teaching moment: First room: the blocker stands in a three-wide doorway with space to pin it on one side. A player who tries to slip past on the side it is guarding is mirrored and touched, so they restart having learned that it tracks them and has to be pinned or lured rather than dodged. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It lives in a three-wide doorway and moves one tile per player move sideways to stay between you and the exit, tracking your position
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It is no longer a disguised keylock: it never leaves its doorway strip, so you get past by pinning it to one side with a pushed block, luring it with a decoy, or crossing behind a guard window

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It is no longer a disguised keylock: it never leaves its doorway strip, so you get past by pinning it to one side with a pushed block, luring it with a decoy, or crossing behind a guard window
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Blocker's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-34-blocker-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #34.
